description: This Java class defines a visitor for converting filter field expressions into predicates for Thing objects. It implements the FilterFieldExpressionVisitor interface and provides methods to generate predicates based on attribute keys, feature IDs and properties, or simple field names.

classes.name: FilterThingPredicateVisitor
classes.description: A visitor that converts filter expressions into Predicates for Thing objects.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method that applies a filter field expression to generate a Predicate<Thing> using the provided predicate function.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Generates a Predicate for a specific attribute key.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Generates a Predicate for a feature ID and property.

methods.name: visitSimple
methods.description: Generates a Predicate for a simple field name.
